mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_box ( box_id, box_number, series_id, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{boxId}, #{boxNumber}, #{seriesId}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT pb.box_id, pb.box_number, p.product_id, p.product_name, bpr.quantity, bpr.sold_quantity, p.product_image, p.product_price, pl.level_name, ps.price, ps.price_ranges, CASE WHEN bpr.sold_quantity >= bpr.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sold_out FROM product_box pb JOIN box_product_relation bpr ON pb.box_id = bpr.box_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bpr.product_id JOIN product_level pl ON p.product_levelid = pl.level_id JOIN product_series ps ON pb.series_id = ps.series_id WHERE pb.series_id = #{seriesId}
